title: Configuration invariant
statement: For natural numbers $s,w,i$ and a machine configuration $\sigma$, the invariant requires its input-length, base, exponent, power, scratch, loop-counter, pop-scratch, and popped-endpoint registers all to be zero. It also requires the radius to equal $s$, the width to equal $w$, the code bound to equal $2^w$, the source and target codes to be less than $2^w$, the midpoint to be at most $2^w$, the level to equal $i$, the endpoint stack to be less than $2^{w(w-i)}$, and the phase stack to be less than $2^{w-i}$.
